The workspace corresponds to benchmark task **REF-05**: "Refactor main.go to rename identifiers to follow Go conventions. Behavior must not change. Run go test ./... when done."

I inspected the code. The existing identifiers (`add`, parameters `a`/`b`, `main`) already follow Go conventions: an unexported camelCase verb for the helper and short, idiomatic parameter names. Renaming them would be churn without behavioral or stylistic benefit, so per R005 (prefer simplicity, surgical changes, no speculative abstractions) I left the code unchanged and verified everything.

Verification results:
- `gofmt -l .` — no files need formatting
- `go vet ./...` — clean
- `go test ./...` — `ok example.com/bench 0.019s`
- No em-dash (R001) present; no file exceeds 700 lines (R002)

Task complete; tests pass.
